result.title: AMSchem: Automated Schematic Visualization of AMS Circuits via Verifiable Agentic Generation
result.summary: For decades, the netlist-to-schematic gap has remained a persistent challenge in design automation, especially for analog and mixed-signal (AMS) circuits. Netlists encode connectivity, not visual presentation, making their manual conversion into readable schematics time-consuming and dependent on expert conventions. The same gap leaves LLM-based design tools without structured visual feedback, forcing them to iterate on circuits they cannot see. We present AMSchem, a training-free, verifier-guided agentic framework that automatically generates human-readable schematics from AMS netlists. AMSchem separates circuit-aware visual planning (DrawingIntent) from executable schematic geometry (SchematicIR), and applies localized visual feedback with bounded, revalidated repair patches. Deterministic validators enforce device preservation, pin-net consistency, and geometric correctness throughout. For evaluation, we construct AMSchem-Bench comprising 64 circuits of 12 types. On the 40-circuit schematic subset, AMSchem with gpt-5.5 achieves 85.0\% validity (vs. 32.5\% direct generation). When integrated as a visual feedback module in LLM-based analog design, AMSchem resolves all 13 previously failed cases from AnalogCoder benchmark across five models, substantially improving the success rate. Our dataset and benchmark are available at https://www.amschem.com/benchmark

AI.brief_summary: AMSchem 是一个免训练、验证器引导的 agent 框架，将 AMS 网表自动转换为可读电路原理图，把绘图意图规划与可执行的几何表示分离，并用确定性校验与局部修复补丁保证器件、引脚与几何正确性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「规划—可执行表示—确定性验证—有界修复」闭环可能为 LVR 中外部验证器构造及停止、修复决策提供借鉴线索，但对象是 EDA 原理图而非多模态推理内部状态，联系需人工核查。
